long_biography.plain_text:
After studying engineering physics and business at Uppsala University, Niklas Zennström began his career in telecommunications before co-founding Kazaa, Joltid and Skype with Janus Friis. Skype's internet-calling model grew into a global communications business. Its successive sales—first to eBay and later as part of Microsoft's acquisition—generated the founder proceeds that established Zennström's principal fortune.

Zennström founded Atomico in 2006 and now serves as its chief executive and founding partner. The venture firm backs technology businesses from early-stage rounds through growth financing. His work has therefore shifted from building communications companies to allocating capital and advising founders, while technology remains the origin of his wealth. Atomico's fund commitments, assets under management and portfolio-company valuations represent capital managed for investors or company-level values; they should not be read as Zennström's personal net worth.
